subject: Radio, Television and Electronics Works
sourceFile: Technical & Trade -- RADIO,TELEVISION AND ELECTRONICS WORKS.txt
examFormat: Three papers, all to be taken; Papers 1 and 2 form a composite paper taken at one sitting. Paper 1: forty multiple-choice objective questions in 45 minutes for 40 marks. Paper 2: six short-structured questions, any four answered in 1 hour for 60 marks. Paper 3: a 2-hour practical test of three skill-based questions of which two are answered, for 90 marks (a list of materials is released at least two weeks earlier); if materials cannot be acquired, a theoretical alternative of two compulsory questions in 2 hours for 100 marks may be used. Industrial attachment (between SS II and SS III) carries 10 marks.
excluded: List of facilities and major equipment/materials.
